evidence_slice: Historic England's official public no-login NHLE v02 FeatureServer exposes layer 3, 'Listed Building polygons', as the polygon layer for listed buildings. Official metadata states polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011 and defines area_ha as the polygon area, only populated where building footprint has been mapped. The official NHLE record 1306502 identifies Bridge Inn, Bridge Hill, Topsham, Exeter, Grade II, amended 7 June 2022, and explicitly describes it as an C18 coaching inn/public house with a rear malthouse/brewery, providing strong building type/use evidence. A distinct exact ListEntry=1306502 single-record query with returnGeometry=true was attempted. The feature payload was not accessible through the available web retrieval channel, and direct network access failed at DNS resolution, so no polygon coordinates or area_ha value were read. The amendment is not assumed to be substantive and no geometry was inferred or fabricated.
